title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention now covers Microsoft Cowork
summary: The briefing passes: its automatic policy extension, controls, licensing detail and rollout statements are supported. The cost rationale should name the listed eligible plans rather than describe all of them as E5-tier plans.

claims.claim: Roadmap item 570845 concerns Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork.
claims.quote: "id": 570845, "title": "Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork"

claims.claim: The roadmap status is Launched.
claims.quote: "status": "Launched", "statusKey": "launched"

claims.claim: The roadmap lists General Availability and Preview release phases.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Preview"]

claims.where: front matter: clouds; Scope: Cloud and platform
claims.claim: The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant).
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.quote: "platforms": ["Web"]

claims.quote: "targetDate": "October CY2026"

claims.where: What's changing; summary; Why it matters
claims.claim: Purview DLP extends to Cowork through a single policy shared with Microsoft 365 Copilot.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to Microsoft Cowork, enabling data security admins to use a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes preventing the use of labelled knowledge sources.
claims.quote: preventing the use of labeled knowledge sources

claims.claim: The roadmap describes blocking prompts containing supported sensitive information types.
claims.quote: blocking prompts that contain supported sensitive information types

claims.claim: The roadmap describes restricting sensitive prompts from being sent to Bing for web search.
claims.quote: restricting sensitive prompts from being sent to Bing for web search.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Existing DLP policies targeting the Microsoft Copilot workload automatically apply to Cowork.
claims.quote: Existing DLP policies that target the Microsoft Copilot workload will automatically apply to Microsoft Cowork.

claims.claim: New DLP policies created for Copilot automatically include Cowork.
claims.quote: New DLP policies created for Microsoft Copilot will automatically include Microsoft Cowork.

claims.claim: No separate configuration is required to extend existing Copilot DLP coverage to Cowork.
claims.quote: No separate configuration is required to extend existing Microsoft Copilot DLP coverage to Microsoft Cowork.

claims.claim: Learn names the shared policy location Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location supports the following conditions and actions:

claims.where: What's changing; Open questions: uploaded files
claims.claim: The notice says prompt DLP and web-search DLP apply only to prompt text, not uploaded files at this time.
claims.quote: Note that Prompt DLP and Web Search DLP applies to the prompt text only, not uploaded files at this time.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: External email blocking is not yet supported for Cowork.
claims.quote: Blocking external email isn't yet supported for Cowork.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Customising the Learn about access restrictions link in Policy Tips is not yet supported for Cowork.
claims.quote: Customizing the link in Copilot policy tips isn't yet supported for Cowork.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope: Learn and the notice differ; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn marks SIT-based prompt blocking as preview and rolling out, including support for Cowork.
claims.quote: This feature is in preview and is rolling out to all tenants with access to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat. Check whether rollout has reached your tenant. Cowork supports this feature

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Sensitivity-label rules prevent Copilot and Cowork from using the content of matching files and emails in responses.
claims.quote: You can create a DLP policy to prevent these Copilot experiences from using files and emails that have sensitivity labels when generating responses.

claims.claim: Items excluded by sensitivity-label rules can still appear in response citations.
claims.quote: Identified items still appear in the citations of the response, but Copilot and Cowork don't access or use the content of the item in the response.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Scope: Email and file coverage
claims.claim: Sensitivity-label email protection covers emails sent on or after January 1, 2025.
claims.quote: Emails sent on or after January 1, 2025.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Scope: Email and file coverage
claims.claim: Calendar invites are not supported by this sensitivity-label protection.
claims.quote: Calendar invites aren't supported.

claims.claim: A sensitivity-label rule supports file items.
claims.quote: File items, which are stored and items that are actively open.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Scope; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: DLP evaluates typed prompt text and cannot scan the contents of files uploaded directly into prompts.
claims.quote: DLP can't scan the contents of files that you upload directly into prompts, so evaluation of the uploaded file for sensitive data doesn't occur. DLP only checks the text you type into the prompt itself.

claims.claim: Copilot prompts run in the security context of the user who submits them.
claims.quote: All Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts run in the security context of the user who initiates the prompt.

claims.claim: Users need existing access to content before it can appear in responses, and DLP can further exclude items.
claims.quote: for a user to see an item in a prompt response, they must first have the necessary permissions to access the content of the item. You can then use the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location feature to exclude items from being processed in the response summary.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance; controls[0].note
claims.claim: Purview Data Security AI Admin is one of the roles that can create or edit these DLP policies.
claims.quote: Purview Data Security AI Admin - Role for editing Data Loss Prevention policies related to Copilot and viewing AI content in Data Security Posture Management.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls: roles
claims.claim: Microsoft Entra AI Admin can create or edit these policies.
claims.quote: Microsoft Entra AI Admin - Role for managing all aspects of Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI-related enterprise services in Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: Learn recommends using roles with the fewest permissions.
claims.quote: Microsoft recommends that you use roles with the fewest permissions.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: DLP policy updates can take up to four hours to reach the Copilot and Cowork experiences.
claims.quote: Updates to a DLP policy can take up to four hours to reflect in the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork experiences.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: SIT conditions and sensitivity-label conditions cannot be combined in one rule but can be separate rules in the same policy.
claims.quote: You can't use both content contains sensitive info types and content contains sensitivity labels conditions in the same rule. You can create a rule for each condition in the same policy, but not in the same rule.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The licensing model for the Microsoft 365 Purview protection is per-user.
claims.quote: The per-user licensing model is the familiar Microsoft 365 E3/E5/A5/F5/G5 model. It remains unchanged. This licensing model enables you to apply Microsoft Purview controls and protections to Microsoft 365 and Windows/macOS endpoint-based assets.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; front matter: licensing.notes
claims.claim: File and email restrictions are included in the listed E5/A5, Purview suite, frontline suite and Information Protection and Governance plans.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 E5/A5, Microsoft Purview Suite/EDU/FLW and Microsoft Defender + Purview Suite FLW, Microsoft 365 E5/A5/F5 Information Protection and Governance | Office 365 E5/A5

claims.where: Cost and licensing; front matter: licensing.notes; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The service description makes prompt protection available to all Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat users.
claims.quote: *Purview DLP for prompts is available to all users of Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat

claims.where: Cost and licensing; front matter: licensing.notes; Open questions
claims.claim: The service description does not name Cowork separately or establish a distinct Cowork DLP entitlement.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Cowork DLP billing license' and 'Purview Cowork DLP meter'; opened the Purview service description, feature page and billing-models page. Searched the service description for Cowork: no match. No separate Cowork DLP entitlement found.

claims.claim: The feature page's licensing section only links to Enterprise Plans and the Microsoft 365 service licensing guidance.
claims.quote:
For information on licensing, see
- Microsoft 365 Enterprise Plans
- Microsoft 365 Service Descriptions

claims.claim: The billing-models page identifies per-user licensing as the model for Microsoft 365 assets.
claims.quote: Per-user license for Microsoft 365 and Windows/macOS endpoint sources

claims.claim: MC1477182 describes no meter or charge for the Cowork DLP extension.
claims.quote: Searched: meter, charge, billing and price in the supplied full Message Center post MC1477182. The notice discusses DLP coverage and automatic policy application, not a meter or charge.

claims.claim: No meter is documented specifically for extending Copilot-location DLP to Cowork at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Purview Cowork DLP meter' and 'Cowork DLP billing license'; read Purview billing models, the service description and feature page. Results describe general Cowork usage charges and other Purview meters, not a meter for this DLP extension.

claims.claim: The notice identifies administrators managing Copilot, Cowork and Purview DLP policies as affected.
claims.quote: Administrators who manage Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Cowork, and Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention policies.

claims.claim: The notice gives Public Preview beginning in late September and expected to complete by early October 2026.
claims.quote: Public Preview: Beginning in late September 2026 and expected to complete by early October 2026

claims.where: Scope: Dates; What's changing: availability distinction
claims.claim: The notice gives Worldwide General Availability beginning in mid-October and expected to complete by late October 2026.
claims.quote: General Availability (Worldwide): Beginning in mid-October 2026 and expected to complete by late October 2026

claims.claim: The notice's end date is 2026-11-30.
claims.quote: Microsoft's end date 2026-11-30

claims.claim: The notice sets no act-by date.
claims.quote: Act by: none

claims.claim: The combined Copilot policy location is available only in the Custom policy template.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location is only available in the Custom policy template.

claims.claim: Selecting the combined Copilot location disables all other locations for that policy.
claims.quote: When you select the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location, all other locations for that policy are disabled.

claims.where: Scope: Policy rules; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Policy simulation mode is available for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork.
claims.quote: Policy simulation mode is available for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork.

claims.claim: The combined location supports administrative-unit scoping, including Cowork.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location supports administrative units for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork.

claims.claim: Administrative-unit support for the location, including Cowork, is preview and rolling out and might not be available in a tenant.
claims.quote: Administrative unit support for this location, including Cowork, is in preview and is rolling out. The option might not yet be available in your tenant.

claims.claim: Administrative-unit DLP scoping follows the user submitting the prompt.
claims.quote: DLP policy scoping for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork is based on the user who submits the prompt, not the owner of a file or email that the experience accesses.

claims.claim: In Microsoft Purview portal the route is Data Loss Prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Custom > Custom policy > Locations > Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork.
claims.quote:
Go to Data Loss Prevention > Policies and select + Create policy.
Select the Custom template, then Custom policy.
On the Locations page, set the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork location to on.

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy -Name "<policy name>" -Locations $loc -EnforcementPlanes @("CopilotExperiences") creates a policy for the Copilot location.
claims.quote: New-DLPCompliancePolicy -Name "Copilot Policy" -Locations $loc -EnforcementPlanes @("CopilotExperiences")

claims.claim: The published PowerShell example creates a Microsoft 365 Copilot policy and a rule using sensitivity labels.
claims.quote:
This example creates a DLP policy for Microsoft 365 Copilot in several steps:
- The first command returns information about all sensitivity labels. Select the GUID value of the sensitivity label that you want to use.

claims.claim: The New-DlpCompliancePolicy reference does not explicitly mention Cowork.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Cowork New-DlpCompliancePolicy'; opened the New-DlpCompliancePolicy reference and searched its text for Copilot and Cowork. It documents the Copilot example and parameters but contains no Cowork mention.

claims.claim: The shared Copilot and Cowork location supports DLP alerts.
claims.quote: DLP alerts and DLP notifications are supported.

claims.claim: The shared Copilot and Cowork location supports DLP notifications.
claims.quote: DLP alerts and DLP notifications are supported.

claims.claim: The standard Learn about access restrictions link opens Microsoft Learn.
claims.quote: When a DLP rule blocks a Copilot interaction, the standard Copilot message includes a Learn about access restrictions link. By default, the link opens Microsoft Learn.

claims.where: Governance controls: separate switch; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn documents no separate Cowork switch within the combined DLP location.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Cowork DLP separate policy'; read the feature page's setup, supported conditions, availability and admin-unit sections, plus MC1477182. They describe the combined location and automatic extension, not a separate Cowork DLP switch.

claims.claim: This DLP extension documents no new agent actions.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Cowork DLP agent actions'; read the roadmap record, MC1477182 and the DLP feature page. These describe policy evaluation and protection, not new agent actions. Search results about Cowork's general actions do not attribute new actions to this extension.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends reviewing existing Copilot DLP policies for their application to Cowork.
claims.quote: Review existing Microsoft Purview DLP policies that target Microsoft Copilot to understand how they will apply to Microsoft Cowork.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends evaluating whether additional labels or SITs should be included in existing policies.
claims.quote: Evaluate whether additional sensitivity labels or Sensitive Information Types should be included in existing policies.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends informing compliance, security and AI governance stakeholders.
claims.quote: Inform compliance, security, and AI governance stakeholders about this expanded coverage.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters
claims.claim: The extension is on without administrator action for existing Copilot-targeting DLP policies.
claims.quote: Existing DLP policies that target the Microsoft Copilot workload will automatically apply to Microsoft Cowork.

claims.claim: The rationale describes the listed file and email protection plans collectively as E5-tier plans.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 E5/A5, Microsoft Purview Suite/EDU/FLW and Microsoft Defender + Purview Suite FLW, Microsoft 365 E5/A5/F5 Information Protection and Governance | Office 365 E5/A5
claims.fix: In the cost rationale, replace 'included only in E5-tier plans' with 'included in the plans listed in Cost and licensing'. The documented list also includes suite and frontline entitlements.

claims.claim: A prompt matching the SIT prompt-blocking rule receives no response.
claims.quote: This policy prevents Copilot and Cowork from returning a response when prompts contain sensitive data.

claims.claim: A prompt matching the web-search rule loses external web search but can still receive a response using permitted internal data.
claims.quote: When a user prompt contains the configured SITs, Copilot and Cowork block external web search as a grounding source and continue to generate the response using allowed internal Microsoft 365 data sources.

claims.where: front matter: cost; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The sources show no new direct charge for the DLP extension, leaving policy review and communication as its identified indirect costs.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Purview Cowork DLP meter' and 'Cowork DLP billing license'; read the service description, billing models, feature page and MC1477182. No new extension charge found; the notice recommends reviewing policies and informing stakeholders. General Cowork consumption is distinct.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls: roles
claims.claim: Purview Compliance Administrator can create or edit these policies.
claims.quote:
Accounts with one of the following roles or role groups can create or edit a DLP policy for the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork location:
[...] Purview Compliance Administrator

claims.claim: Microsoft Entra Global Admin can create or edit these policies.
claims.quote:
Accounts with one of the following roles or role groups can create or edit a DLP policy for the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork location:
[...] Microsoft Entra Global Admin

claims.claim: The DLP policy can have tenant scope.
claims.quote: An unrestricted administrator can scope policies to administrative units or keep Full directory to apply a policy across the organization. Existing tenant-wide policies continue to apply; using administrative units is optional.
